request-prompt: Show placeholder mockups of lists (like 'Watch Later' and 'Playlists') underneath the sign-in promo so I can see what organizational features will become active once I log in.
goal: I like to actively organize and manage my content by saving videos to custom playlists and Watch Later lists so I can systematically watch them later.
jobs: I want to sign in to my YouTube account to access my personalized library of saved videos.
I want to look up a video I recently watched by checking my watch history.
I want to access my 'Watch Later' list to watch the videos I saved for my leisure time.
I want to browse my custom playlists to watch or listen to my curated collections.
I want to see the list of videos I have liked in the past to find a specific video again.
I want to search for a video or topic using the top search bar.
I want to navigate to other areas of YouTube, such as Home, Shorts, or Subscriptions, using the side menu.

preference-pairs.a: I always stay logged in to my accounts to ensure my history, preferences, and curated playlists are seamlessly synced across all my devices.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer to browse websites signed out or in private modes because I highly value my privacy and do not want platforms tracking my personal viewing habits.

preference-pairs.a: I like to actively organize and manage my content by saving videos to custom playlists and Watch Later lists so I can systematically watch them later.
preference-pairs.b: I rarely save content or curate playlists; I prefer to search for what I want on the spot or rely on instant algorithmic recommendations.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer a clean, minimal interface that focuses solely on my content, and I find promotional banners and sign-in prompts highly distracting.
preference-pairs.b: I do not mind promotional banners and call-to-action prompts occupying screen space, as I am used to standard layouts and easily look past them to find what I need.

preference: I like to actively organize and manage my content by saving videos to custom playlists and Watch Later lists so I can systematically watch them later.
